nodes.label: Battery-Conserving Background Imports
nodes.rationale: Background imports are disabled by default and, when enabled, run every 30 minutes to conserve battery.

nodes.label: Non-Recursive Source Scanning
nodes.rationale: Recursive filesystem watchers were removed because they could trigger repeated full scans.

nodes.label: Antigravity Visible Context Estimation
nodes.rationale: Cumulative visible request context, exposed thinking, and serialized tool-call output are estimated because only observable Antigravity transcript content is available.

nodes.label: Antigravity Prompt Cleaning
nodes.rationale: Prompt wrappers and injected workspace metadata are omitted so stored prompts better reflect user-authored input.

nodes.label: Local-Only Privacy Model
nodes.rationale: Indexed usage remains private by staying local, avoiding telemetry and network synchronization, treating histories as read-only, and never reading authentication files.

nodes.label: Legacy Antigravity Language-Server Bridge
nodes.rationale: The optional bridge is restricted to the local language server and does not persist or log its temporary CSRF value.

nodes.label: Safe Deletion Mirroring
nodes.rationale: Indexed copies are removed only after a complete successful scan so partial scans cannot cause accidental deletion.

nodes.label: Per-Source Usage Accuracy Model
nodes.rationale: Accuracy labels differ by source because Codex and OpenCode expose reported usage while Antigravity lacks authoritative local Gemini usage metadata.

nodes.label: Antigravity Observable Lower Bound
nodes.rationale: Observable prompt metadata, history, tool calls, and results establish a lower bound, while unknown system context and caching remain excluded.

nodes.label: Separate Cached-Input and Reasoning-Output Accounting
nodes.rationale: Cached-input and reasoning-output values are displayed separately to prevent double-counting in totals.

nodes.label: Manual Refresh by Default
nodes.rationale: Source tools retain their own histories, so manual catch-up avoids continuous scanning and its battery cost without losing usage records.

nodes.label: Development Verification Packaging and Visual QA
nodes.norm_label: development verification packaging and visual qa

nodes.label: Compact Webview Typography and Density
nodes.rationale: The implementation is denser than the concept so the dashboard remains useful inside a narrow VS Code webview.

nodes.label: VS Code Theme-Compatible Source Palette
nodes.rationale: Charcoal and source-specific accent colors retain concept identity while remaining compatible with VS Code theme variables.

nodes.label: Responsive Webview Layout
nodes.rationale: Panels stack, filters wrap, and the table scrolls horizontally so dense usage data remains usable at 390 by 844 pixels.

nodes.label: Data-Driven Runtime Copy
nodes.rationale: Core concept labels are retained while dates, models, projects, and token figures remain driven by runtime data.

nodes.label: Intentional Fidelity Deviations
nodes.rationale: Runtime content intentionally differs from sample data, and macOS-native rendering was not validated because development occurred on Windows.
